title: Facet force at L5-S1 - Rousseau MA, Bradford DS, Hadi TM, Pedersen KL, Lotz JC 2006 (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: mean contact force on facets +/- SD (pressure-sensitive film) under imposed posture + 650 N compression + 550 N shear

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Rousseau MA, Bradford DS, Hadi TM, Pedersen KL, Lotz JC 2006); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Rousseau MA, Bradford DS, Hadi TM, Pedersen KL, Lotz JC 2006, as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Imposed angular position (0, +/-6 deg) with 650 N compression and 550 N shear.
how_to_simulate: Impose 0 or 6 deg flexion/extension/lateral posture on L5-S1
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Rousseau MA, Bradford DS, Hadi TM, Pedersen KL, Lotz JC 2006.

data.load: 0 deg flexion + 650 N compression + 550 N shear
6 deg flexion + 650 N compression + 550 N shear
6 deg extension + 650 N compression + 550 N shear
6 deg lateral + 650 N compression + 550 N shear
-6 deg lateral + 650 N compression + 550 N shear

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output. | 2026-11-12: source.n was the primary paper year (2006); primary n not available here, set to null.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
